messages.subject: Project Atlas - completion mechanics and funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Miriam,

We are set for completion tomorrow, 23 January. The completion funds flow statement and completion checklist are final (in the deal folder). Buyer funds required at completion are GBP 52.5m (GBP 50m completion cash to Harland Vesey client account plus GBP 2.5m retention to the escrow account), with a separate GBP 8.2m to Yorkshire Commercial Bank to redeem the facility. Please confirm the funds will be in position by 10am. The Brampton board minutes and stock transfers are in agreed form.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
